visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Maximum Subarray (Kadane)
visualizerParams.description: At each number choose between extending the current run and starting a new one, and keep the best run seen so far.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
def max_subarray(nums):
    best = current = nums[0]
    for n in nums[1:]:
        current = max(n, current + n)
        best = max(best, current)
    return best


print(max_subarray([-2, 1, -3, 4, -1, 2, 1, -5, 4]))
print(max_subarray([-4, -1, -8]))
